title: Manu mobbtogle
description: An simmple mobtoggle Plugin for paper
body:
Key Features & Technical Details
 Full 1.21 Support: Fully compatible with all Paper 1.21 to 1.21.11 versions.
 Automatic Mob Removal: Automatically clears all hostile mobs within a 10-block radius every 5 seconds.
 Beautiful Action Bar Display: Features a brand-new, polished Action Bar update! The status is now displayed more elegantly than ever—keeping your chat 100% free from spam.
 Easy Control: Players can effortlessly turn the feature on or off using the simple ⁠/mobtoggle⁠ command.
